meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过命令行完成视频渲染、预览和部署
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在本地或云端命令行渲染视频
copy.tagline_en: Render, preview, and deploy videos from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to render videos locally or in the cloud via CLI

howto.what: Claude 可以运行 HyperFrames CLI 命令，帮助你完成视频项目的初始化、编写、检查、预览、渲染等步骤，还能诊断构建或渲染失败。
howto.when: 当用户想要使用 HyperFrames CLI 开发循环，或需要诊断构建/渲染失败时，Claude 会接管并执行相关命令。

say.text: 帮我用 hyperframes init 初始化一个项目。
say.note: Claude 会运行 init 命令创建新项目。

say.text: 运行 hyperframes check 检查当前项目。

howto.what_en: Claude can run HyperFrames CLI commands to help you scaffold, author, lint, check, preview, render, and more for video projects, and also diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: When the user wants to use the HyperFrames CLI development loop or needs to diagnose build/render failures, Claude takes over and executes relevant commands.

say_en.text: Initialize a project with hyperframes init.
say_en.note: Claude runs init to create a new project.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes check on the current project.
say_en.note: Claude runs check, including lint and browser audit.

say_en.text: Render the final video with hyperframes render --quality high.
